etsy.title: ADHD Humor Sticker, I Have a Thing at 4 So Today Is Cancelled, Funny Neurodivergent Vinyl Decal
etsy.description:
An adhd humor sticker that says it all: I have a thing at 4:00, so today is cancelled. Bold type with a handwritten subtitle, for the waiting mode that wipes out the whole day.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, planner, or desk. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: 'adhd humor sticker' is an indexed Etsy market page. The 'waiting mode' concept (one appointment cancels the whole day) is widely relatable in ADHD communities but rare as a sticker design.

Time blindness stickers on Etsy include 'TIME Blindness CLUB' and 'Sorry I'm Late I Was Time Blind' designs. Our design captures a different angle: not lateness, but the paralysis of having something scheduled.
Single ADHD humor stickers are typically $3-$6.
Amazon ADHD sticker packs focus on hyperfocus, side quests, and too-many-tabs themes. 'Waiting mode' or 'cancel plans' stickers are uncommon, making this a gap.
